title: KiCad
acceptance_criteria: The repo has one or more of the following: 1) files with extensions for KiCad projects, schematics, PCBs, symbol libraries, or footprint libraries, 2) plugins that assist KiCad, 3) software utilities that accept and/or generate files for KiCad, 4) skills or MCPs that allow an AI or LLM to work with KiCad. Reject personal portfolio pages and pages with lists having many links to non-KiCad items.

title: SKiDL
acceptance_criteria: The repo has one or more of the following: 1) one or more Python files that use SKiDL to create electronic systems 2) software utilities that accept and/or generate SKiDL, 3) skills or MCPs that allow an AI or LLM to work with SKiDL. Reject personal portfolio pages and pages with lists having many links to non-SKiDL items.

title: FOSS Chips
search_terms: SKYWATER OR GF180MCU OR openlane OR wafer.space

title: Embedded RTOSes
search_terms: FreeRTOS OR NuttX OR Zephyr OR RIOT

title: Kendryte Microcontrollers
search_terms: maix OR kendryte OR K210 OR K230 OR K510

title: El-Cheapo Microcontrollers
search_terms: RP2040 OR RP2350 OR CH32V OR PY32F
acceptance_criteria: The repo has one or more of the following that involve these microcontrollers: 1) source code files that target one or more of them 2) software utilities for working with them, 3) descriptive or executable files for building electronic or physical systems that contain them 4) skills or MCPs that allow an AI or LLM to work or design with them. Reject personal portfolio pages and pages with lists having many links to non-SKiDL items.
